summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — distinct from `euryalus-zacynthus` in Epitome 7.29 and from the Phaeacian boxer Euryalus at Alcinous' games.

story.text: Apollodorus names Euryalus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Amphimachus and before Paralus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
Apollodorus lists another Euryalus among the wooers from Zacynthus in Epitome 7.29 — see `euryalus-zacynthus`. Neither is the Phaeacian prince who boxed with Odysseus at Alcinous' games.
